name: Credit cover response reason code
description: Code specifying the reason for a response to a request for credit cover.

values.name: Requested financial information not provided
values.description: Requested financial information not provided Party requested has not provided financial information.

values.name: No financial information available
values.description: No financial information available No financial information is available on buyer.

values.name: Debtor is out of business
values.description: Debtor is out of business Debtor ceased trading activities.

values.name: Debtor is new company
values.description: Debtor is new company Debtor is newly incorporated.

values.name: Debtor is not registered
values.description: Debtor is not registered Debtor is not formally registered as legal entity.

values.name: Debtor is non-trading company
values.description: Debtor is non-trading company Debtor without trading, e.g. holding company.

values.name: No comment
values.description: No comment No information can be disclosed.

values.name: Only insolvency risk covered
values.description: Only insolvency risk covered Only the risk of insolvency is covered.

values.name: Subject to acceptance of bill of exchange
values.description: Subject to acceptance of bill of exchange Limit cover conditional to buyer's acceptance of bill of exchange.

values.name: Document against acceptance
values.description: Document against acceptance Limit given on documents against acceptance terms.

values.name: Document against payment
values.description: Document against payment Limit given on documents against payment terms.

values.name: Adverse information is publicly available
values.description: Adverse information is publicly available Adverse information on buyer is publicly available.

values.name: Credit limit full
values.description: Credit limit full No approval or increase in credit possible.

values.name: Lack of turnover
values.description: Lack of turnover Limit reduced. E.g. cancelled due to absence of activity.

values.name: Other
values.description: Other Reasons not otherwise specified here.
